tasks.task: Test the link addition functionality by adding a new link to the user’s link tree.
tasks.expected: The newly added link appears in the user's link tree with the inputted title and URL.

tasks.task: Test the link editing functionality by modifying the title and URL of an existing link in the user’s link tree.
tasks.expected: The link displays updated information in the link tree after saving changes.

tasks.task: Test the link deletion functionality by deleting an existing link from the user’s link tree.
tasks.expected: The link is removed from the link tree, and there is no residual data displayed regarding the deleted link.

tasks.task: Test the sharing functionality by copying the link tree's shareable link.
tasks.expected: The shareable link is copied to the clipboard without errors, enabling sharing with others.

tasks.task: Test the form validation by attempting to add a new link with incomplete fields.
tasks.expected: A validation error message is displayed, preventing the user from adding the link until all required fields are completed.

tasks.task: Test website navigation by navigating between the home page, link tree dashboard, and user profile.
tasks.expected: Each navigation click takes the user to the correct page, without any errors.

tasks.task: Verify that the website uses 'papaya whip' as the background color and 'dark orange' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
tasks.expected: The website has a background color of 'papaya whip' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'dark orange', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

tasks.expected: The Top 3 reads My Portfolio, YouTube Channel, Merch Store in that order — Merch Store (not Newsletter) takes third place because the 987-click tie breaks alphabetically by title.

tasks.expected: A Blog row appears on Analytics showing 0 clicks and 0.0%, and the overall total still reads 6,356 clicks.

tasks.expected: Gallery appears in the link list showing the title Gallery and the URL gallery.casey.co.

tasks.expected: YouTube Channel now shows 1,205 clicks and the tree total reads 6,357 clicks.

tasks.task: Open the Preview page with the viewing-as-of date at its default of July 1, 2026 and look over the buttons.
tasks.expected: Exactly 5 buttons show: Merch Store is missing (its window starts August 1) while Book a Call is present (its window runs through July 10).

tasks.expected: Book a Call is still shown on July 10 (the end date is inclusive) and disappears on July 11, updating live without a page reload.

tasks.expected: The schedule is rejected with a visible validation message because the end date is before the start date, and no window gets saved on Podcast.

tasks.expected: Merch Store no longer appears even though August 5 falls inside its scheduled window — Hidden overrides the schedule.

tasks.task: On the Analytics group rollup, find the Community group.
tasks.expected: Community shows 88 clicks even though Discord, its only link, is Hidden.

tasks.task: Open the Preview page (viewing-as-of left at July 1, 2026) and look at the section headers.
tasks.expected: Work, Content, and Offers appear as sections in that order, and no Community header shows because nothing in it is visible — no empty section.

tasks.task: In the link manager's Content section, click Move Up on Podcast, then click Move Up on Podcast again.
tasks.expected: The first click puts Podcast above YouTube Channel; the second click leaves the order unchanged with no error, since Podcast is already at the top of its group.

tasks.task: In the link manager, click the pin toggle on Podcast, then click it again to unpin.
